entries.852df44105d41786: This is the group's sole business. As a holding company, the company formulates and executes the group's consolidated management strategy and conducts real estate leasing; its 100%-owned subsidiary McDonald's Japan Co., Ltd. operates stores under the company-operated store model and expands stores under the franchise model. The company pays royalties to McDonald's Corporation of the United States for licenses it grants, and it grants sub-licenses of know-how and trademarks to domestic franchisees, from which it receives royalties. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥416,602 million.

entries.9cd9d4002cb8aa56: The company is a holding company with Japan McDonald's Co., Ltd. (100% owned) under it, which operates hamburger restaurants, and it formulates and executes consolidated management strategy for the group and conducts real estate leasing operations. Its head office is located in Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo, and consolidated employees number 2,454 (as of December 31, 2025).
entries.a7566d7e332daff5: In the medium-term management plan announced in February 2025 (fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2027), it aims to remain “Japan's most beloved restaurant brand” and, to keep growing over the long term, focuses on 3 areas: “Menu Value,” “Store Portfolio and Digital,” and “Sustainability and People,” and aims to be “No.1 for customers” by strengthening and expanding regionally rooted franchise business. As its basic management policy, it cites thorough food safety and security and the provision of store experiences with high convenience and QSC (quality, service and cleanliness).
